page_title: BOC 1-0 STU | Bochum v Stuttgart 20/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' Substitution. Matus Bero makes his way off the pitch and Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) comes on as his replacement.
90+6' A yellow-coloured card is received by Moritz Broschinski (Bochum).
90+5' The referee Bastian Dankert awards Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) a yellow card.
90+5' That's a clear yellow card. Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) goes into the book.

90+4' The cross into the penalty area from Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball goes out of play and Bochum will have a goal kick.
90+3' Stuttgart quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90+1' Roberto Massimo (VfB Stuttgart) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
86' Manuel Riemann leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart).

85' Well-positioned Waldemar Anton (VfB Stuttgart) was first to the rebound and fired in a shot towards the right post, but Manuel Riemann reacted superbly to keep the ball out. The fans could not believe their eyes. It was a miraculous stop!
85' Stuttgart are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
85' Patrick Osterhage (Bochum) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
83' Stuttgart hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
79' Thomas Letsch has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) replacing Christopher Antwi-Adjei.
78' The corner is swung in but Bochum can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
78' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) fires a shot from close range, but he is somehow only able to hit the right post!
75' Sebastian Hoeness prepares a substitution. Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) is replaced by Roberto Massimo.
70' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
70' Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it just wide of the right post.
67' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
66' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
66' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Stuttgart comes to nothing. The referee signals a corner kick to Stuttgart.
65' Thomas Letsch decides to make a substitution. Goncalo Paciencia will be replaced by Moritz Broschinski (Bochum).
64' We are about to witness a subsitution. Ivan Ordets (Bochum) for Philipp Forster.
61' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) is first to react to a loose pass inside the box, but slices his shot just wide of the right post.
59' The resulting corner from Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
58' Golden opportunity! Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) lost his marker inside the box, only to shoot just wide of the left post after receiving a good pass.
56' Bernardo (Bochum) latches on to a superb cross into the box and plants a header well wide of the right post.
56' Bastian Dankert blows for a foul after Waldemar Anton (VfB Stuttgart) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
53' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Philipp Forster (Bochum). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
53' The attendance for today's match is 25000.

50' 1 - 0 Goal! Christopher Antwi-Adjei displays great vision and sends a pass to Matus Bero (Bochum), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom right corner. The score is 1:0.
48' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) plays a through ball but overhits it.
47' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Stuttgart.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
45' Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
42' Yellow card. Philipp Forster (Bochum) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
41' Yellow card! It's like Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Bastian Dankert agrees and books him.
40' The number of shots on goal at present is 0:2.
38' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) collects the ball from the free kick and immediately sends his close-range effort just over the crossbar!
36' Bernardo (Bochum) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
35' Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
30' Bochum are awarded a free kick.
30' Bastian Dankert blows his whistle as Matus Bero (Bochum) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.

27' What a save from Manuel Riemann! Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
27' Manuel Riemann (Bochum) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
23' Philipp Forster (Bochum) takes a snap shot from the edge of the box after a rebound, but his effort is a waste as it goes high over the bar.
22' Stuttgart are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
19' Referee Bastian Dankert sees the trip by Patrick Osterhage (Bochum) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
15' Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Patrick Osterhage.
11' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it high over the bar.
10' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes miles wide of the right post.
10' Some neat passing and movement from Stuttgart as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
8' The ball is cleared after Patrick Osterhage (Bochum) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
5' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom left corner, but Manuel Riemann pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
4' Goncalo Paciencia (Bochum) trips an opposition player and Bastian Dankert signals a foul.
2' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Bochum will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Bastian Dankert.
